metas.name: Get Rich Quick Porky
metas.description: Porky invests his savings. Mayhem ensues.

metas.name: Porky's Poppa
metas.description: We take a tour of Porky's Poppa's farm, to the tune of Old MacDonald. After meeting several animals, "on this farm, he has a mortgage" which he frets over, particularly since Bessie has stopped producing milk. Poppa orders an Acme milk producing robot, and the beast vs. machine battle is on.

metas.name: The Night Watchman
metas.description: A little cat must take his sick father's place as night watchman, but is bullied by a tough mouse and his gang, leaving the rest of the mice free to eat all the food and stage a musical floor show.

metas.name: Dog Gone Modern
metas.description: The Two Curious Puppies visit a model home with a panoply of modern inventions, including an annoying robot that sweeps up anything that touches the floor.

metas.name: Robin Hood Makes Good
metas.description: A fox captures two young squirrels while they're playing "Robin Hood". Their small younger friend uses his ingenuity to try to rescue them.

metas.name: Prest-O Change-O
metas.description: Fleeing from a dog catcher, the Two Curious Puppies run to an old remote house where, upon entering, they are continually subject to the antics of a mischievous magician's rabbit and surprise by the house's magical items.

metas.name: Daffy Duck and the Dinosaur
metas.description: Casper Caveman is hungry, so he tries to hunt for a duck, Daffy Duck.

metas.name: Naughty But Mice
metas.description: Sniffles the mouse, in his first appearance in a Warner Bros. cartoon, goes to a drugstore and gets drunk on a cold remedy, then befriends an electric razor and gets it drunk as well.

metas.name: Old Glory
metas.description: Porky Pig balks at learning the Pledge of Allegiance until Uncle Sam appears to him in a dream and gives him a lesson in American history.

metas.name: Snowman's Land
metas.description: In the Canadian north, a little Mountie runs afoul of the dread outlaw, Dirty Pierre.

metas.name: Little Brother Rat
metas.description: Sniffles the mouse has to get an owl's egg for a scavenger hunt, but once he's gotten it, the egg hatches and draws the attention of the mouse-eating father owl.

metas.name: The Little Lion Hunter
metas.description: Out hunting in the jungle with his spear, African native boy Inki keeps narrowly missing his prey: a parrot, a giraffe, even a butterfly. Then there's that weird black bird with the syncopated hop who keeps popping up out of nowhere, only to disappear mysteriously once again. Back to big game huntin

metas.name: The Good Egg
metas.description: A hen adopts an abandoned egg which hatches into a turtle. The baby turtle becomes the butt of all the real chicks' jokes until danger threatens.

metas.name: Sniffles and the Bookworm
metas.description: Literary characters come to life late at night in a bookshop, serenading Sniffles the mouse with swing music until the Frankenstein monster intrudes.

metas.name: The Curious Puppy
metas.description: While pursuing a little dog who's wandered into an amusement park at night, the park's watchdog accidentally switches on the power to all the rides and attractions, bewildering the pair of canines.

metas.name: Mighty Hunters
metas.description: Native American children play in the canyons of Arizona.

metas.name: Elmer's Candid Camera
metas.description: Elmer takes up wildlife photography but finds his subject, a rabbit, much too rascally.

metas.name: Sniffles Takes a Trip
metas.description: Sniffles the mouse is in the country for a restful vacation of fresh air, enjoyment of nature, and peace and quiet.

metas.name: Tom Thumb in Trouble
metas.description: Tom's father mistakenly believes that the little bird who's just rescued his tiny son from drowning in the dishwater is attacking the boy and drives it away. Tom sets off to find the bird and gets lost in a fierce snowstorm.

metas.name: The Egg Collector
metas.description: Sniffles the mouse and his friend the Bookworm decide to take up egg collecting, setting their eyes upon a big barn owl egg. But the big barn owl isn't so hot on the idea.

metas.name: Ghost Wanted
metas.description: An inexperienced little ghost tries out for a house-haunting job, but winds up getting terrorized by the fat ghost interviewing him for the position.

metas.name: Stage Fright
metas.description: The Two Curious Puppies wander into a theater and run afoul of a trickster magician's rabbit, a playful seal and an intimidating little bird.

metas.name: Good Night Elmer
metas.description: Elmer Fudd spends an endless night trying to fall asleep amid myriad frustrations, in particular, a candle that won't go out.

metas.name: Bedtime for Sniffles
metas.description: Christmas Eve, and Sniffles is determined to stay awake to see Santa. Not an easy task.

metas.name: Elmer's Pet Rabbit
metas.description: Elmer Fudd gets more than he bargained for from his new pet rabbit.

metas.name: Sniffles Bells the Cat
metas.description: Sniffles the mouse's friends talk him into putting a bell around the neck of the troublesome house cat.

metas.name: Joe Glow, the Firefly
metas.description: A firefly with a miner's lighted helmet explores a camper's tent and the various people-sized items that, from his perspective, are gigantic, then utters the cartoon's single line of dialog.

metas.name: Porky's Ant
metas.description: In Africa, Porky tries to catch a rare pygmy ant.

metas.name: Toy Trouble
metas.description: Sniffles the mouse and his friend the Bookworm try to evade a cat in a the toy department of Lacy's department store.

metas.name: Porky's Prize Pony
metas.description: When jockey Porky's thoroughbred gets drunk on linament, a goofy milk-wagon horse takes over for the big race.

metas.name: Inki and the Lion
metas.description: Preceded by thunderous crashing from the jungle, a little black bird with a syncopated hop emerges from the brush to mystify big-game hunter Inki as he attempts to track down his prey: a ferocious daddy lion.

metas.name: Snow Time for Comedy
metas.description: The Two Curious Puppies chase after a bone in the snow-bound wilderness, contending with dam-building beavers and treacherous thin ice.

metas.name: The Brave Little Bat
metas.description: When his car breaks down out in the country, Sniffles the mouse takes shelter in an old mill, where he meets up with "Batty," a non-stop-talking little bat who later save Sniffles from a hungry cat.

metas.name: Saddle Silly
metas.description: A Pony Express rider's adventures in getting the mail through Indian country.

metas.name: Porky's Midnight Matinee
metas.description: Working backstage at a theater, Porky frees a little ant he finds in a cage, only to learn that it's a rare and valuable trained pygmy ant.

metas.name: The Bird Came C.O.D.
metas.description: Conrad Cat, has trouble getting a prop tree he's delivering to a theater into the door. Once inside, he falls victim to an intimidating little bird who hops out of a magician's hat.

metas.name: Porky's Cafe
metas.description: Porky uses his cafe's kitchen's mechanical gadgets to fix a meal for a diner, while cook Conrad Cat deals with an ant in the pancake mix.

metas.name: Conrad the Sailor
metas.description: Conrad, a sailor aboard a Navy battleship, is swabbing the deck when he is interrupted and tormented by Daffy Duck.

metas.name: Dog Tired
metas.description: The Two Curious Puppies get into mischief at the zoo.

metas.name: The Draft Horse
metas.description: In a burst of patriotism, a farm horse tries to join the army but finds out he's not really soldier material.

metas.name: Hold the Lion, Please
metas.description: A lion wants to prove he's still "King of the Jungle" and, to prove it, he hunts rabbit.

metas.name: The Squawkin' Hawk
metas.description: Henery Hawk, making his first appearance in a Warner Bros. cartoon, refuses the worm his mother is trying to feed him; after all, he's a chicken hawk. That night, he sneaks out to the hen house, but comes up against a protective rooster.

metas.name: Fox Pop
metas.description: Hearing that silver foxes are all the rage in high society, a fox paints himself silver and gets himself trapped, finding out too late that it's only his fur anyone is interested in.

metas.name: The Dover Boys at Pimento University or The Rivals of Roquefort Hall
metas.description: Three fun-loving, morally upright brothers from Pimento University save their fiancée from their fiendish archenemy, Dan Backslide, in this spoof of the Rover Boys.

metas.name: My Favorite Duck
metas.description: Porky tries to relax on a hunting and fishing trip, but Daffy, smugly pointing out the "No Duck Hunting" signs, subjects him to constant irritation. Then the "Duck Hunting Season Open" signs start going up.

metas.name: Case of the Missing Hare
metas.description: After a traveling magician puts a poster over the entrance to his home, Bugs visits his act to get revenge.

metas.name: To Duck.... Or Not to Duck
metas.description: Daffy challenges duckhunter Elmer to a boxing match, rigged in his favor with the collusion of the duck referee. In the stands, Elmer's dog Larrimore suspects that something funny is going on, but he's drowned out by Daffy's all-duck cheering section.

metas.name: Flop Goes the Weasel
metas.description: While Mammy is gone to catch a worm for her about-to-hatch egg, a weasel steals the egg for his breakfast. When the egg hatches, the blabbermouth chick initially mistakes the weasel for his Mammy.

metas.name: Super-Rabbit
metas.description: Bugs Bunny becomes a superhero who does battle with a rabbit-hating cowboy and his horse.

metas.name: The Unbearable Bear
metas.description: Sniffles the mouse's non-stop talking foils both the burglar and a tipsy Officer Bear, who's trying to sneak past his rolling pin-toting, sleepwalking wife.

metas.name: The Aristo-Cat
metas.description: Meadows the butler quits after being tormented by the spoiled family cat, who finds he is unable to survive on his own, especially after meeting the mice Hubie and Bertie.

metas.name: Wackiki Wabbit
metas.description: On a tropical island, a pair of castaways look to Bugs as a source of food.

metas.name: Fin'n Catty
metas.description: "As everyone knows," the narrator begins, "goldfish must have water... and cats hate water." And so it goes.

metas.name: Inki and the Minah Bird
metas.description: Once again, the mysterious minah bird hops his syncopated way into Inki's lion-hunting expedition. This time the little black bird has a new reality-defying way to disappear: he hops into a haystack which gradually (and with the same catchy hip-hop) shrinks down to a single straw, which vanishes.

metas.name: Tom Turk and Daffy
metas.description: It's Thanksgiving, and Tom Turk is trying to avoid become the main attraction on Porky Pig's dinner table. Fellow bird Daffy Duck is willing to help him, until he realizes that he'll miss out on a delicious meal. Hilarity ensues as each tries to get the other caught by Porky.

metas.name: Bugs Bunny and the Three Bears
metas.description: The bears tempt Goldilocks with carrot soup, the scent of which brings Bugs on the scene. Bugs romances Mama Bear, and she becomes infatuated with him.

metas.name: The Weakly Reporter
metas.description: A newsreel spoof with WWII homefront gags, including rationing, air raid drills and women filling in men's jobs.

metas.name: Angel Puss
metas.description: A little black boy is hired to kill a cat, but the feline escapes and proceeds to play tricks on the kid, pretending he's a ghost come back to haunt his "killer".  One of the “Censored 11” banned from TV syndication by United Artists in 1968 for racist stereotyping.

metas.name: From Hand to Mouse
metas.description: "Spare me!" pleads the mouse to the dumb lion who just caught him, "And some day I'll save your life." Once out of the lion's clutches, though, the mouse taunts, "Sucker!"

metas.name: Lost and Foundling
metas.description: A mouse adopts a hawk.

metas.name: Odor-Able Kitty
metas.description: A cat, tired of being abused by everyone in his neighborhood, disguises himself as a skunk and inadvertently attracts the romantic advances of a real skunk.

metas.name: Trap Happy Porky
metas.description: Porky can't sleep because mice demolish his plates. A cat offers help and gets the mice out, but invites some friends so Porky still can't sleep.

metas.name: Hare Conditioned
metas.description: Bugs Bunny is working in the display window of a department store when the manager tries to move him to the taxidermy department and have him stuffed.

metas.name: Fresh Airedale
metas.description: Shep the dog is seen by his master as loyal and loving, but the cat knows he is really a self-centered, conniving weasel who lets burglars in the house and takes credit for the good deeds of others.

metas.name: Hare Tonic
metas.description: When Elmer Fudd brings Bugs Bunny home for dinner main course, Bugs tricks him into thinking there is a terrible outbreak of Rabbititus.

metas.name: Quentin Quail
metas.description: Take-off on Fanny Brice's "Baby Snooks" radio program. An exasperated Mr. Quail tries to catch a worm for his whining daughter, Baby Toots, and gets the worst from a tough crow who has designs on the worm himself.

metas.name: Hush My Mouse
metas.description: Take-off on the "Duffy's Tavern" radio program, with tough-guy Eddie G. Robincat demanding a meal of mouse knuckles, "of which we ain't got none," waiter Filligan informs his absentee boss on the phone. To fill the plate, Filligan then tries to catch the blabbermouth mouse, Sniffles.

metas.name: Hair-Raising Hare
metas.description: A sneaker-wearing, hairy monster chases Bugs through a castle belonging to an evil scientist.

metas.name: The Eager Beaver
metas.description: Anxious to get to work with the big guys damming the river before the flood hits, a little beaver keeps getting in the way of their work. Finally, the foreman sends him off to chop down that big tree "way over there." Meanwhile, the flood rushes closer and closer.

metas.name: Fair and Worm-er
metas.description: One long chase: worm chases apple; bird chases worm; cat chases bird; dog chases cat; dogcatcher chases dog; dogcatcher's wife chases dogcatcher; mouse chases dogcatcher's wife. With occasional interruptions by a skunk.

metas.name: Roughly Squeaking
metas.description: Scheming mice Hubie and Bertie convince a cat that he is, in fact, a lion.

metas.name: Scent-imental Over You
metas.description: Striving to be like all the high-class dogs in their fine coats, a little hairless pooch borrows a black and white fur coat of her owner, not realizing it makes her appear to be a skunk. Once she has it on, she finds everyone fleeing from her - everyone, that is, except for the amorous Pepé Le Pew.

metas.name: Inki at the Circus
metas.description: Sitting dejected in a circus cage, billed as an African "wildman," Inki becomes the target of two dogs, both of them after the bone in his topknot. But luckily for Inki, the mysterious minah bird, syncopated hop and all, has also been captured and sent to the same circus.

metas.name: A Pest in the House
metas.description: A very tired businessman needs some sleep and checks into a hotel run by Elmer Fudd, where Daffy Duck is the bellhop.

metas.name: House Hunting Mice
metas.description: Mice Hubie and Bertie wander into an automated house of tomorrow.

metas.name: Little Orphan Airedale
metas.description: Charlie Dog, looking for a good home and some easy living, thinks he's found the perfect sap in Porky Pig. He tries to ingratiate himself with the pig, all the way avoiding Porky's attempts to get rid of the dead-beat dog.

metas.name: A Feather in His Hare
metas.description: A hungry indian tries to cook bugs, yet Bugs outwits him yet again. Banned for offensive depiction of Native Americans.

metas.name: What's Brewin', Bruin?
metas.description: Pa Bear's attempts to hibernate are constantly frustrated by Junyer's snoring, Ma repeatedly opening the window, a persistent drip from the ceiling and finally, the voices of spring.

metas.name: Rabbit Punch
metas.description: Heckling the Champ gets Bugs into the world championship fight as the challenger.

metas.name: Haredevil Hare
metas.description: Bugs is the test rabbit shot to the moon. There, he meets Commander X-2, who is intent on destroying the Earth with his Aludium Q-36 Explosive Space Modulator.

metas.name: You Were Never Duckier
metas.description: Finding that the prize for best duck at the National Poultry Show is only $5.00, but $5,000 for the best rooster, Daffy disguises himself as one, but then becomes the object of Henery Hawk's chicken hunt.

metas.name: Daffy Dilly
metas.description: Tired of selling gag novelties on the street, Daffy tries for the million-dollar reward offered by J.P. Cubish for the first person to make him laugh. But he first has to get past the rich man's haughty butler, and in the process subjects the servant to a Bogart-like grilling.

metas.name: My Bunny Lies Over the Sea
metas.description: In Scotland, Bugs Bunny rescues a woman from a monster. The "woman" is a kilted Scotsman, and the "monster" is his bagpipe. The Scotsman then challenges Bugs to a game of golf.

metas.name: Scaredy Cat
metas.description: Porky Pig and Sylvester the Cat spend the night in an old dark house, whose horrors only Sylvester sees.

metas.name: Awful Orphan
metas.description: Porky Pig's quiet life in his high-rise apartment building is rudely disrupted when an obnoxious mutt sneaks in and refuses to leave.

metas.name: Mississippi Hare
metas.description: After getting mixed in with a bale of cotton, Bugs ends up on a Mississippi riverboat, where he meets up with the notorious gambler Col. Shuffle.

metas.name: Mouse Wreckers
metas.description: Mice Hubie and Bertie drive Claude the cat insane through an escalating series of head games.

metas.name: The Bee-Deviled Bruin
metas.description: It's breakfast time, and Pa finds the honeypot empty. Literally risking life and limb, he has Junyer help him raid a nearby beehive. In the end, he finds he should have listened to Ma in the first place, rather than telling her to "Shaddap!"

metas.name: Long-Haired Hare
metas.description: Bugs Bunny vs. a famous opera singer at the Hollywood Bowl.

metas.name: Often an Orphan
metas.description: Abandoned in the country by his old master, Charlie Dog tries to force himself upon farmer Porky Pig, playing upon his sympathies with a histrionic rendition of the horrors of big-city life.

metas.name: Fast and Furry-ous
metas.description: This was the debut for Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner. It was also their only cartoon made in the 1940s. It set the template for the series, in which Wile E. Coyote (here given the ersatz Latin name Carnivorous Vulgaris) tries to catch Roadrunner (Accelleratii Incredibus) through many traps, pla

metas.name: Frigid Hare
metas.description: Bugs rescues a penguin from an Inuit hunter at the South Pole and becomes obligated to it beyond his wildest dreams.

metas.name: For Scent-imental Reasons
metas.description: Pepé Le Pew invades a Parisian perfumery, where he sniffs the various scents. The shopkeeper runs in horror and recruits a female cat to run the skunk out of the shop. She tosses the cat inside, and a bottle of dye falls over, accidentally painting a white stripe down the cat's back. Pepé gives chas

metas.name: Bear Feat
metas.description: The three bears try to train to become vaudeville stars, but things do not go well for Pa Bear.

metas.name: Rabbit Hood
metas.description: While trespassing in the royal gardens in search of carrots, Bugs runs afoul of the Sheriff of Nottingham, who tries to apprehend him for poaching. Of course Bugs sets out to endlessly turn the tables on the hapless sheriff.

metas.name: Homeless Hare
metas.description: A construction worker destroys Bugs' home with a steam shovel and refuses to repair the damage.

metas.name: The Scarlet Pumpernickel
metas.description: Daffy tries to sell movie studio head J.L. his script for a swashbuckler set in Merry Olde England, a plot involving a maiden in distress, a scheming Chamberlain, an evil Grand Duke and a dashing masked hero (to be played by Daffy, of course).

metas.name: The Hypo-Chondri-Cat
metas.description: Those crazy mice Hubie & Bertie are at it again with Claude. This time the mice see that Claude is seriously ill, so they give him an operation.

metas.name: 8 Ball Bunny
metas.description: Bugs helps a penguin return home.

metas.name: Dog Gone South
metas.description: Charlie Dog attempts to ingratiate himself to a southern plantation owner.

metas.name: The Ducksters
metas.description: Quiz-show contestant Porky is the one who's supposed to be penalized each time he misses a question, but host Daffy is the one who winds up getting safes and boulders dropped on him and deluged by torrents of water.

metas.name: Caveman Inki
metas.description: Back in prehistoric times, a thundering earthquake splits a mountain wide open, and out hops the minah bird, to alternately bedevil, mystify and rescue Inki as he hunts dinosaurs. Meanwhile, a pelt-bedecked caveman persists in his attempts to make a pot of stew, which keeps getting overturned each t

metas.name: Rabbit of Seville
metas.description: Behind the Hollywood Bowl stage which is playing the opera The Barber of Seville, Bugs Bunny flees into the backstage area with Elmer Fudd in close pursuit. Seeing his opportunity to fight on his terms, Bugs raises the curtain on Elmer, trapping him on stage. As the orchestra begins playing, Bugs co

metas.name: Two's a Crowd
metas.description: Claude Cat is determined to get rid of the mistress's birthday present: a new puppy.

metas.name: Bunny Hugged
metas.description: Bugs Bunny gets involved in a wrestling match to save Ravishing Ronald from the Crusher.

metas.name: Scent-imental Romeo
metas.description: A hungry cat disguises herself as a skunk to get in on feeding time at the zoo, but amorous Pepé thinks she's the real thing and pours on his Maurice Chevalier impression to win her over.

metas.name: A Hound for Trouble
metas.description: Kicked off the boat in Italy, Charlie forces himself upon a pizzeria owner. Donning his best Italian accent and garb, Charlie sets to work as a waiter, astonishing and horrifying the customers with his barefoot grape-stomping and musical rendition of "Atsa Matta for You?"

metas.name: Rabbit Fire
metas.description: Daffy Duck and Bugs argue back and forth whether it is duck season or rabbit season. The object of their arguments is hunter Elmer Fudd.

metas.name: Chow Hound
metas.description: A muscular dog exploits a cat and a mouse for food, but they keep forgetting to bring him gravy!

metas.name: The Wearing of the Grin
metas.description: Porky Pig spends the night at an Irish castle after being caught in a storm, and gets in trouble with the two leprechauns who live there.

metas.name: His Hare Raising Tale
metas.description: Bugs tells stories to his nephew Clyde derived from earlier cartoons ("Baseball Bugs", "Stage Door Cartoon", "Rabbit Punch", "Falling Hare", and "Haredevil Hare").

metas.name: Cheese Chasers
metas.description: After eating their fill at a cheese factory, Hubie and Bertie decide there is nothing left to live for, and try to get Claude Cat to eat them.

metas.name: A Bear for Punishment
metas.description: Junyer Bear has a number of surprises for Good Ol' Pa on Good Ol' Father's Day, whether he wants them or not.

metas.name: Drip-Along Daffy
metas.description: Daffy Duck plays a western hero, but things don't go as he hoped in a one horse town.

metas.name: Operation: Rabbit
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote, genius, announces to Bugs Bunny that he is going to catch him and eat him, and then employs a variety of gadgets and plans in an attempt to do so.

metas.name: Feed the Kitty
metas.description: A bulldog adopts an adorable kitten, but he can't let his owner know.

metas.name: Little Beau Pepé
metas.description: After driving the Foreign Legionnaires from their fort with his aroma, lovesick skunk Pepe falls for the camp mascot, a cat who's accidentally gotten a white stripe painted down her back.

metas.name: Water, Water Every Hare
metas.description: Bugs Bunny's rabbit hole floods, causing him to float to the laboratory of an evil scientist who wants to use his brain for a robot.

metas.name: Beep, Beep
metas.description: The Coyote chases the Road Runner through a maze of mine shafts.

metas.name: The Hasty Hare
metas.description: A Martian, with his green dog-soldier, K-9, arrive on Earth with instructions to bring back an Earth creature. He chooses Bugs Bunny.

metas.name: Going! Going! Gosh!
metas.description: The Coyote makes various attempts to get the Road Runner with an explosive-tipped arrow, by shooting himself out of a sling shot and by covering the road with quick drying cement.

metas.name: Mouse-Warming
metas.description: A teen-aged boy mouse falls in love with the girl mouse who lives in the hole across the room. But Claude Cat literally comes between them, and also tries to stir up a feud between their two families.

metas.name: Rabbit Seasoning
metas.description: Elmer Fudd is hunting both Daffy Duck and Bugs Bunny again.

metas.name: Terrier-Stricken
metas.description: Frisky Puppy's sudden barking and playful antics send Claude Cat on wild rides through their house, down the chimney, in and out of faucets, out the door, and eventually diving into an empty swimming pool.

metas.name: Don't Give Up the Sheep
metas.description: A sheepdog thwarts the efforts of a thieving wolf whose tricks include altering the time clock, hiding in a bush, imitating Pan, digging a tunnel, unleashing a wildcat and disguising himself as the dog's coworker.

metas.name: Forward March Hare
metas.description: Bugs Bunny gets a draft notice by mistake and joins the army, with disastrous results, especially for the sergeant of his platoon.

metas.name: Kiss Me Cat
metas.description: Marc Antony must convince his owner that Pussyfoot is a great mouser to keep him in the house.

metas.name: Duck Amuck
metas.description: The short-tempered Daffy Duck must improvise madly as the backgrounds, his costumes, the soundtrack, even his physical form, shifts and changes at the whim of the animator.

metas.name: Much Ado About Nutting
metas.description: A squirrel in a downtown park lugs a giant coconut back home, but nothing he tries will crack it open.

metas.name: Wild Over You
metas.description: A wildcat escapes from the zoo, disguises herself as a skunk to fool her pursuers, but that only attracts lovestruck Pepe le Pew.

metas.name: Duck Dodgers in the 24½th Century
metas.description: Space hero Daffy battles Marvin the Martian for control of Planet X.

metas.name: Bully for Bugs
metas.description: Bugs Bunny, once again making that "wrong turn at Albuquerque", burrows into a bullring where a magnificent bull is making short work of a toreador. The bull bucks Bugs out of the arena, prompting the bunny to declare "Of course you realize, this means war!" The deft Bugs' arsenal comes plenty packe

metas.name: Zipping Along
metas.description: Hypnosis doesn't help the Coyote catch the Road Runner, nor do a clutch of string-controlled rifles or dozens of mousetraps, but they all manage to backfire on him, naturally.

metas.name: Lumber Jack-Rabbit
metas.description: Bugs Bunny stumbles on the carrot patch of Paul Bunyan, but doesn't realize that it is guarded by a 124-foot, 4,600-ton dog named Smidgen.

metas.name: Duck! Rabbit, Duck!
metas.description: The final installment of the "Hunting Trilogy" once again has Elmer out hunting, while Bugs and Daffy try to con him into shooting the other.

metas.name: Punch Trunk
metas.description: A tiny elephant emerges from a banana boat and wanders about town, causing an uproar among the populace. Sightings are attributed variously to mass hysteria, insanity and dipsomania.

metas.name: Feline Frame-Up
metas.description: After Claude frames Marc Antony, making it look like the bulldog ate the kitty, Marc must try various methods of getting back at Claude from outside the yard.

metas.name: No Barking
metas.description: A homeless cat (Claude Cat) searching for food is harassed by the playful antics and barking of an energetic pup (Frisky Puppy). Frisky repeatedly sneaks up behind the poor tabby cat (who hates the dog) and scares it into jumping vertically when it barks. After Claude finally silences the pup, he en

metas.name: The Cats Bah
metas.description: Penelope, an American tourist cat who's gotten a white stripe of paint down her back, is pursued through the Casbah by the amorous skunk Pepe Le Pew, who woos her with his rendition of "As Time Goes By".

metas.name: Claws for Alarm
metas.description: Porky and Sylvester stay overnight in what Sylvester realizes is a terrifying hotel filled with endless imminent danger.

metas.name: Bewitched Bunny
metas.description: Bugs must rescue Hansel and Gretel from Witch Hazel's clutches.

metas.name: Stop! Look! and Hasten!
metas.description: A Burmese tiger trap, a pop-up steel wall, a motorcycle, and a box of Acme-brand leg-building vitamins can't help the Coyote (Eatibus anythingus) catch the Road Runner (Hot Rodicus supersonicus).

metas.name: From A to Z-Z-Z-Z
metas.description: Ralph is a daydreamer... and he is quick to adapt his current surroundings into new, adventurous dreams.

metas.name: My Little Duckaroo
metas.description: Daffy Duck is a Wild West outlaw named "The Masked Avenger", righter of wrongs and doer of heroic deeds. Porky Pig is his sidekick. Together, they seek to arrest Nasty Canasta, a villain whose crimes include gag-stealing and square dancing in a round house.

metas.name: Sheep Ahoy
metas.description: After punching in for work, Sam Sheepdog deals with Ralph Wolf's attempts to steal the flock, which this time make use of a balloon, a fake Acme-brand rock and a bicycle-propelled submarine.

metas.name: Baby Buggy Bunny
metas.description: Baby-Faced Finster robs a bank, but the baby carriage with the money in it goes down Bugs' rabbit hole.

metas.name: Beanstalk Bunny
metas.description: Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck (as Jack) find themselves at the top of a beanstalk where they get chased around by a giant Elmer Fudd.

metas.name: Ready.. Set.. Zoom!
metas.description: Among the strategies that fail in Wile E. Coyote's attempts to catch the Roadrunner: glue on the road, a giant rubber band, an outboard motor in a wash tub, and dressing in drag as a female Roadrunner.

metas.name: Past Perfumance
metas.description: Paris, 1913: Passionate, odiferous Pepe Le Pew pursues the latest love of his life, a cat who's been made up to look like a skunk, through the sets of a silent-movie studio.

metas.name: Rabbit Rampage
metas.description: Bugs Bunny is playfully harassed by his animator.

metas.name: Double or Mutton
metas.description: Ralph Wolf wants to steal sheep; Sam Sheepdog wants to stop him. Ralph's tricks include digging a tunnel, walking a tightrope, launching a guided missile, dressing as Little Bo Peep, shooting a cannon and growing Sam's hair.

metas.name: Jumpin' Jupiter
metas.description: A strange alien captures Porky Pig and Sylvester's entire campsite as a sample to take back to its planet, but only Sylvester figures out what is really going on.

metas.name: Knight-Mare Hare
metas.description: An apple falls on Bugs' head, transporting him back to King Arthur's England.

metas.name: Two Scent's Worth
metas.description: A crook disguises a cat as a skunk to scare people out of a bank. Soon after, great lover Pepé Le Pew sees her and the chase is on through the French Alps.

metas.name: Guided Muscle
metas.description: While cooking a tin can, the Coyote spots a better meal rushing by: the Road Runner.

metas.name: One Froggy Evening
metas.description: A workman finds a singing frog in the cornerstone of an old building being demolished. But when he tries to cash in on his discovery, he finds the frog will sing only for him, and just croak for the talent agent and the audience in the theater he's spent his life savings on.

metas.name: Bugs' Bonnets
metas.description: A passing truck spills a variety of hats, causing Elmer and Bugs to change personalities in rapid succession to fit the headgear they wind up wearing.

metas.name: Broom-Stick Bunny
metas.description: On Halloween night, Bugs Bunny, masquerading as a witch, trick-or-treats at the creepy old mansion of Witch Hazel, who prides herself on being the ugliest witch of all.

metas.name: Rocket Squad
metas.description: In a futuristic city, Detectives Monday and Tuesday pursue a wanted criminal.

metas.name: Heaven Scent
metas.description: On the French Riviera, a female cat is frightened by sudden outbursts of barking by every dog around her. So, to scare them away, she paints her back with a white stripe like that of a skunk. But she doesn't receive the peace she'd expected, because Pepé Le Pew, the amorous French skunk, sees her, t

metas.name: Gee Whiz-z-z-z-z-z-z
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote unsuccessfully chases the Road Runner using such contrivances as a rifle, a steel plate, a dynamite stick on an extending metal pulley, a painting of a collapsed bridge (which the Coyote falls into while Road Runner passes right through), and a jet motor.

metas.name: Barbary-Coast Bunny
metas.description: After Bugs' giant gold nugget is stolen by Nasty Canasta, he tries to win it back at Canasta's San Francisco gambling hall.

metas.name: Rocket-bye Baby
metas.description: A cosmic mix-up results in a Martian baby being delivered to Earth, while an Earth baby is sent to Mars. Joseph Wilbur and his wife try to raise the green-skinned, ingenious Martian tyke as if he were an Earthling. But the kid builds his own spaceship and flies away, and Wilbur must find him and bri

metas.name: Deduce, You Say
metas.description: Daffy Duck is a detective who is hunting for the Shropshire Slasher.

metas.name: There They Go-Go-Go!
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote is hungry and schemes to catch the Road Runner.

metas.name: To Hare Is Human
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote, genius, tries to catch Bugs Bunny with the help of a Univac Electronic Brain.

metas.name: Scrambled Aches
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote uses, among other things, a dehydrated boulder to try to catch the Road Runner.

metas.name: Go Fly a Kit
metas.description: The story of a cat, raised by an eagle, who learns to fly and uses his ability to save his future girlfriend from a vicious bulldog.

metas.name: Ali Baba Bunny
metas.description: Bugs and Daffy get lost on the way to Pismo Beach, and find a cave full of treasure in the Arabian Desert, guarded by Hassan.

metas.name: Boyhood Daze
metas.description: Ralph gets sent to his room for breaking a window. There, he passes the time in Walter Mitty-type fashion, daydreaming that he's a parent-saving jungle explorer, an alien-fighting jet ace and a convict.

metas.name: Steal Wool
metas.description: Ralph Wolf tries to forcibly remove Sam Sheepdog in order to gain access to a flock of sheep. Without success, he uses a lasso, cannon, a string of firecrackers, and a giant rubber band.

metas.name: What's Opera, Doc?
metas.description: Elmer Fudd is again hunting rabbits - only this time it's an opera. Wagner's Siegfried with Elmer as the titular hero and Bugs as Brunnhilde. They sing, they dance, they eat the scenery.

metas.name: Zoom and Bored
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote uses a bottle full of bees, a brick wall, a boulder in a catapult, and a harpoon gun in his attempts to catch the Road Runner.

metas.name: Touché and Go
metas.description: The amorous skunk, Pepé le Pew, chases a female cat by the seaside, under the sea and finally on a desert island.

metas.name: Robin Hood Daffy
metas.description: Daffy attempts to convince Porky, as Friar Tuck, that he really is Robin Hood.

metas.name: Hare-Way to the Stars
metas.description: Bugs Bunny groggily climbs out of bed and his hole and, unknowingly, into a rocket ship that's parked directly above. It transports him into outer space, where he is chased by martians.

metas.name: Whoa, Be-Gone!
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote's plans for catching the Road Runner involve a giant elastic spring, a gun and trampoline, TNT sticks in a barrel, and tornado seeds.

metas.name: To Itch His Own
metas.description: Mighty Angelo the Flea takes a vacation on a dog in the country. The muscular insect becomes the little mutt's protector when he is bullied by Butcher the bulldog.

metas.name: Hook, Line and Stinker
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote hopes to catch the Road Runner using a mallet, a cooking pan, a TNT stick, a balloon, and a piano dropped from a precipice. The last of these results in Wile E. falling to the road below along with the piano and ending up with 88 teeth.

metas.name: Hip Hip-Hurry!
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote is once again after the Road Runner, this time resorting to hand grenades, dynamite, falling rocks and a speed potion (which contains vitamins R, P and M).

metas.name: Cat Feud
metas.description: Bulldog Marc Anthony, guarding a construction site, finds a kitten, Pussyfoot, to whom he affectionately gives a wiener for lunch. A hungry grown cat sees and is determined to have the wiener.

metas.name: Baton Bunny
metas.description: Bugs conducts the Warner Brothers Symphony in Franz von Suppé's "Morning, Noon, and Night in Vienna" while reacting to a bothersome fly.

metas.name: Hare-abian Nights
metas.description: Bugs entertains the Sultan with tales from his cartoons: "Bully for Bugs", "Sahara Hare" and "Water, Water Every Hare".

metas.name: Hot-Rod and Reel!
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote's failed efforts to catch the Road Runner involve the use of roller skates, a gun in a camera, a trampoline, a dynamite stick on a crossbow, a bogus railroad crossing, and a jet-powered unicycle.

metas.name: Really Scent
metas.description: Pepe le Pew arrives in New Orleans, where Fabrette the black cat has been cursed with white stripes like a skunk, interfering with her chances to get married. Of course, a skunk is her perfect match... if she can stand the smell!

metas.name: Wild About Hurry
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote tries to catch the Road Runner by enclosing himself inside an indestructible steel ball.

metas.name: A Witch's Tangled Hare
metas.description: Rabbit - in this case Bugs - is an important needed ingredient in Witch Hazel's brew.

metas.name: Unnatural History
metas.description: Are animals human? Or vice versa? This is the question asked by a professor, Dr. Beest Lee, who appears on a stage in a theater to give a lecture and show a film about the human-like qualities of various cartoon animals, among them a beaver who "damns" a troublesome river, a groundhog who uses techn

metas.name: Fastest with the Mostest
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote tries to drop a rocket bomb on the Road Runner from a balloon but inflates himself instead.

metas.name: Who Scent You?
metas.description: A female cat wants to board a French cruise ship. Prior to the ship's departure, she crawls under a freshly-painted gate and gets a white streak atop her back and tail. Enter enamored Pepé Le Pew.

metas.name: Rabbit's Feat
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote decides to cook and eat Bugs, but Bugs is on to his plan and tries to escape by acting looney.

metas.name: Ready, Woolen and Able
metas.description: A hungry Ralph Wolf wants to swipe and eat some of the sheep in Sam Sheepdog's flock. Not only does Sam foil all of Ralph's schemes.

metas.name: Hopalong Casualty
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote tries to catch the Road Runner using a dynamite stick on a fishing pole, a Christmas present wrapping machine, and ACME Earthquake pills.

metas.name: High Note
metas.description: The sheet music for Johann Strauss' The Blue Danube is constructed by moving musical symbols. A baton-toting conductor note tries to direct his fellow notes in performing this musical piece, but finds that one of the notes has become drunk.

metas.name: Zip 'n Snort
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote tries to catch the Road Runner using a sling shot, a grenade in a toy airplane whose propeller detaches and leaves the plane behind.

metas.name: The Mouse on 57th Street
metas.description: An inebriated mouse with a throbbing head takes a priceless diamond, thinking it's a soothing piece of ice. Two policemen, one of them a lunkhead, are assigned to recover the missing jewel.

metas.name: The Abominable Snow Rabbit
metas.description: Bugs and Daffy get lost on the way to Palm Springs and end up in the Himalayas, where they meet an Abominable Snowman who has always wanted a rabbit for a pet.

metas.name: Lickety-Splat
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote chases the Road Runner with roller skis, a bow, a rifle, a boomerang, an anvil, and several exploding darts let loose from a balloon.

metas.name: A Scent of the Matterhorn
metas.description: In the French Alps, an out-of-control street-painter's wagon sprays a stripe of white paint atop a female cat's back. Enter Pepé Le Pew.

metas.name: Compressed Hare
metas.description: Bugs battles Wile E. Coyote. A ten trillion volt electric magnet draws everything imaginable.

metas.name: Beep Prepared
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote tries yet again to catch the Road Runner.

metas.name: Nelly's Folly
metas.description: Nelly the Giraffe is discovered in Africa and leaves to begin a singing career, but finds that chasing fame brings her nothing but unhappiness.

metas.name: A Sheep in the Deep
metas.description: Ralph Wolf and Sam Sheepdog punch into work, with Sam guarding a flock of sheep against Ralph's attempts to snatch some mutton for dinner. Ralph uses a lull-a-bye record to put Sam to sleep and steals one of the sheep, but the lamb unzips itself to reveal someone very unexpected beneath!

metas.name: Adventures of the Road-Runner
metas.description: Adventures of the Road-Runner is an animated film, directed by Chuck Jones and co-directed by Maurice Noble and Tom Ray. It was the intended pilot for a TV series starring Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner, but was never picked up until four years later when Warner Bros. Television produced The Roa

metas.name: Zoom at the Top
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote tries to catch the Road Runner using a bear trap with a bird seed bait, a jet rocket, an ice-making machine, and a boomerang.

metas.name: Louvre Come Back to Me!
metas.description: Pepe Le Pew, the eternally amorous skunk, is in Paris, where his stench sends a female cat upward to hit a freshly painted flagpole, which puts a white stripe on her back and causes Pepe to think she also is a skunk. He lustfully pursues her into the Louvre art gallery.

metas.name: Martian Through Georgia
metas.description: Way out in space, on another world whose population is contented, one of its people decides that travel broadens the mind and relieves boredom. So, he flies to Earth in hope of helping the alien Earthlings improve their lot, only to cause panic and be declared a monster just because he looks differe

metas.name: I Was a Teenage Thumb
metas.description: George Ebenezer Thumb and his wife, Prunhilda, are a medieval, rural, English couple who desperately want a child...

metas.name: Now Hear This
metas.description: In this surreal cartoon that plays with the idea of sound effects, a near-deaf old man finds one of the devil's lost horns and tries to use it as an ear trumpet.

metas.name: Woolen Under Where
metas.description: Ralph Wolf and Sam Sheepdog are friends, housemates and coworkers who become bitter enemies, but strictly while they're on the clock. A suit of armor, a skin diving outfit, a unicycle and a makeshift tank figure in Ralph's schemes.

metas.name: Hare-Breadth Hurry
metas.description: When Bugs Bunny takes the Road Runner's place in this Wile E. Coyote cartoon, the roles and rules become confused.

metas.name: Mad as a Mars Hare
metas.description: Marvin the Martian is monitoring through his telescope a rocket launch on Earth. The rocket heads straight for him and lands on Mars. The only occupant is Bugs Bunny, lured into Cape Canaveral by a carrot and sent to Mars as an expendable "astro-rabbit". Bugs is to claim Mars in the name of the Eart

metas.name: Transylvania 6-5000
metas.description: Bugs is given a room for the night at the castle of Count Bloodcount in Transylvania.

metas.name: To Beep or Not to Beep
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote hopes to stop and catch the Road Runner using a huge, boulder-throwing catapult. But no matter where Wile E. positions himself, the catapult drops the boulder on him.

metas.name: The Iceman Ducketh
metas.description: When Daffy hears that the Klondike trading post is paying good money for furs, Bugs' pelt becomes endangered.

metas.name: War and Pieces
metas.description: After another failed series of attempts to catch the ever-elusive Road Runner with a grenade, a bow, a rope, invisible paint, and a gun disguised as a peep show, Wile E. Coyote uses a rocket to chase after the bird. The rocket goes off course, crashes through the earth and sends Wile E. to China whe

metas.name: Roadrunner a Go-Go
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote uses slow motion photography to record his failures at catching the Road Runner in hopes.

metas.name: Zip Zip Hooray!
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote suspends his chase with the Road Runner to explain to two young boys watching him on TV why he wants to catch the speedy bird.
